display_name: 源模拟微扰相对观测残差的能量诊断
description: 仅源模拟数据，计算四种 1% RMS 人工扰动的模拟输出能量与同记录 received 减模拟 clean 作用的残差能量之比。
authorization: 用户继续授权研发星地恢复网络；仅源域合法 IQ 诊断，不重启已停止任务。

code.environment: N607 CPU, two threads, CUDA disabled; PYTHONPATH=/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261109-phase1-source-perturbation-visibility-s2026092701-r01-release:/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261109-phase1-cumulant-context-s2026092701-r01-release:/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261108-phase1-joint-particle-s2026092701-r01-release:/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261108-phase1-spectral-quotient-both-s2026092701-r01-release:/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261101-phase1-physical-rich-router-s2026092701-r01-release:/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/pamf_stage2_inference_20261021_r01:/home/szu2070436088/2510044040/CV-SincNet/releases/20261027-phase1-pamf-repl-shuffled-views-m16-r02-release

data.representation: source received/clean IQ and simulator kernel, widely-linear coefficients, variance
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 672 frozen source pilot physical IDs, RX4/6 and RX8 by seven views; read indices/rx/scene/split only

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Previously explored fixed source pilot; RX8 is source held group, not independent to DURA

permissions.claim_scope: Source-only privileged simulator oracle, IQ NMSE not identity accuracy or performance upper bound

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: frozen_dura source-only provenance and epoch19 matching source action cache
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original source-only DURA, no F or target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed original DURA; no target score selection

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only, preserve all GPU and other owner tasks
execution.stop_rule: Stop on source contract mismatch, nonfinite values, zero residual energy or failed first-batch real-checkpoint source smoke; preserve other owners.

expected_artifacts: result.json: 12 source receiver/practical cells × 4 directions, median and quantiles of perturbation-to-residual energy in dB

metric_names: source synthetic perturbation response energy divided by observed-minus-simulated-clean residual energy, dB

rows.method: Compare ||H(delta)||^2 against ||received-H(clean)||^2 on 1%-RMS synthetic perturbations and matched source simulator H
rows.purpose: Assess whether current synthetic response training signals are small relative to source residual; no F or TX supervision
rows.seed_notes: Existing pretrained source runs and fixed source pilots; no stochastic training, support or augmentation in this benchmark.
rows.budget_ref: 576 fixed source practical observations, batch16, CPU only; first batch real-checkpoint no-query smoke

notes: Relative energy is not an actual SNR or an information-theoretic limit: residual includes noise and representation mismatch, while perturbations are synthetic and not proven device identity features.
Source simulator action and clean are privileged only for source diagnostic, never target inference; no F/TX/V/target or training.
Source pilot has been explored and DURA may have seen source observations; no running or preregistered model is selected, modified or stopped based on this diagnostic.
